description.value:
Three peoples fight the same war with the same physics and opposite manners. A Soul Reaper carries their own soul as a sword, and it argues with them. A Hollow ate its own heart and wears the hole; its power is sealed inside it rather than carried. A Quincy owns no soul-weapon at all — they reach into the air, take the spirit particles that are already there, and make a bow out of them.

You are a martial focus-user whose pool refills by fighting. Every technique costs 1 Reiatsu Point, and Rising Pressure hands one back the first time each round you deal damage with your spirit weapon or take damage from an enemy — on a hard per-encounter ceiling.

Key Attribute Strength or Dexterity

Hit Points 10 plus your Constitution modifier

Initial Proficiencies

Perception Trained

Saving Throws Expert in Fortitude, Expert in Reflex, Trained in Will

Skills Trained in Religion, trained in Spirit Lore, trained in your Lineage skill, and trained in a number of additional skills equal to 3 plus your Intelligence modifier

Attacks Trained in simple weapons, martial weapons, unarmed attacks, and your spirit weapon

Defenses Trained in light armor and unarmored defense

Class DC Trained in your Reiatsu DC
